q: After inserting only "apple", why does search("app") return False?
options: The node for the last 'p' isn't marked as a word end
why: The path exists, but no word ends there.

q: After inserting only "apple", what does startsWith("app") return?
why: startsWith only checks that the path exists.

q: Searching a word of length L in a trie holding n words costs…
why: One step per character, regardless of n.

q: Which question does a trie answer much faster than a hash set?
options: Is any stored word starting with "ca"?
why: A set would have to check every word for the prefix.

q: Search with '.' wildcards (Add and Search Words): what happens at a '.'?
options: Recurse into every child of the current node
why: The dot can be any letter, so every branch has to be tried.

q: Why use a trie for Word Search II (many words, one board)?
options: One DFS follows all words at once and stops as soon as no word has the current prefix
It uses less memory than the board
why: Running a separate search per word repeats the same walks many times.
